claim_ineligibility_reason: This catalogue defines metric contracts only. It contains no candidate run, Gold labels, environment receipt, or numerical result and cannot support a quality or comparative claim.

measurement_policy.zero_denominator_rule: A zero or undefined denominator is recorded as not_executed for that metric; it is never converted into a numerical result or a success state.
measurement_policy.result_binding_requirement: A later measurement report must bind the exact candidate bytes, frozen corpus and Gold identity, host/model, projection and Authority plane, environment, run configuration, and reproducible run receipt before reporting an observation.
